description: Three MOKE hysteresis loops as marker clouds (blue down-triangles 300 K, black squares 80 K ZFC, red diamonds 80 K FC; each with a thin dashed line of its colour), field -1000..1000 Oe, normalized signal -1.25..1.25: a four-quadrant Origin chart in a closed box frame with light-grey gridlines and black zero lines through the origin; the FC loop is shifted right of the origin (exchange bias). Outward ticks on the bottom and left frame lines (majors every 300 Oe / 0.5, minors halfway), majors mirrored inward on the top frame line, majors and minors inward on the right one. Journal figure (Nayyef et al. 2023, Sci Rep 13:10902, Fig. 4 panel a; crop x 0-942, y 0-865 of the publisher's 2007x1725 PNG), 942x865 PNG. Hand-labelled by pixel analysis (Pillow/NumPy/SciPy): positions are image pixels, origin top-left, integer = pixel centre, +/- ~1 px. Provenance and licence: fixtures/real/PROVENANCE.md.

xAxis.notes: axisLineRow is the bottom frame line (black, 3 px), which carries the ticks; the black zero line (row 398.34) carries none. Outward majors (8 px) at -900..900 every 300 Oe, outward minors (4 px) halfway; majors mirrored inward on the top frame. Bold labels -900 ... 900 below; frame corners are -1000 / 1000 Oe (no tick).

yAxis.notes: axisLineCol is the left frame line (black, 3 px), which carries the ticks; the vertical zero line (col 515.37) carries none. Outward majors at -1.0..1.0 every 0.5, minors at the quarters; all mirrored inward on the right frame line. Bold labels "1.0" ... "-1.0"; frame corners are +/-1.25.

paperValues.paper: ~180 Oe (text; Fig. 4d shows ~187 Oe at 80 K)
paperValues.pixels: red FC loop crosses M = 0 at about -31 and +467 Oe (marker clouds, +/- 10 Oe): shift ~218 Oe
at H = 0 the red ascending branch is on its -1.0 plateau (row ~651)

pitfalls: Four-quadrant: the black zero lines (row 398.34, col 515.37) cross the frame but carry no ticks; the ticks hang on the bottom/left frame lines (outward) and are mirrored inward on the top/right.
Header text above the frame with numbers in it: "a." and "dFe = 70 A   dAu = 4 A" (subscripts) - not tick labels.
Legend with marker samples and dashed-line samples inside the frame at the top left (300 K, 80 K ZFC, 80 K FC).
Series are dense marker clouds (hundreds of overlapping markers) joined by thin dashed lines; the three loops overlap near the origin and are not single-valued in x.
Bold Times-like labels; minus signs are hyphen-like dashes; light-grey gridlines at every major.
